programme.desc: Yugi teaches Rebecca that success depends on the player's heart, not the cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba becomes trapped inside a virtual-reality game.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The quest to rescue Kaiba continues with a little help from Mai, but Yugi and friends must adapt to a virtual world where the rules and strategies keep changing every step of the way.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi rescues Kaiba, but they are still stuck in the game; the only exit is past the five-headed Dragon, but in the difficult duel, Joey, Mokuba and Mai lose all their life points; Yugi and Kaiba must put aside their animosity to face the dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: A new student defeats Joey and makes him wear a dog costume in public.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi agrees to play a new game in exchange for Joey's freedom.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi uses his gaming skills against Duke, but his position soon becomes hopeless.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi rescues Joey from Duke.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a child, and the lure of its dark, corrupting power leads Kai to a shocking decision.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demolition Boys who quickly go up 2-0 in the best of five events. In the next match, Michael has to square off against a mystery member of the Demolition Boys and it turns out to be none other than Kai who has defected from the Bladebreakers. In the final battle, Kai takes on all the All Starz at once' and wins!! After his victory, he commands the All Starz Bit Beasts to enter his blade and he announces to the world that he now possesses the most powerful Beyblade in the world!!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tells him to leave. Will the Bladebreakers survive the loss of their most powerful member?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his friends. Unfortunately he loses his Bit-Beast, Draciel, in the process'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally confuses Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. But in the first set, Seaborg, Spencer's whale Bit Beast, uses the water in the Black Sea Bowl to create a tsunami, which overwhelms Dranzer. Kai is desperate for victory and Voltaire makes him a tempting offer: the power of Black Dranzer in exchange for betraying his friends and stealing their Bit Beasts. Kai stays true to his heart and resists his grandfather.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After Kai's first round loss to the Demolition Boys in the World Beyblade Finals, it's Ray's turn to take on Bryan in a best-of-three match. Ray learns the hard way that Bryan is a nasty competitor who'll do anything to win - including putting Ray himself through the ringer. When it's discovered that Bryan's attack includes the ability to manipulate air itself into a weapon, Ray faces a troubling realization. To negate Bryan's fury, he must put his own well being at risk. But Ray's Bit-Beast Driger has other ideas, and it offers up selfless act of its own.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After a devastating match puts Ray in the hospital, Tyson trains his heart out to prepare for his battle against Tala, leader of the Demolition Boys. What Tyson doesn't know is that Tala has become one of Boris' weird experiments, uploaded with dangerous Biovolt technology. Meanwhile, Max's parents work together to come up with an improved Beyblade that can combat the existing threat of the Demolition Boys' prowess. Can it even come close to competing against'Cyber-Tala?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It is the finals of the World Beyblading Championships in Moscow with Tala from the Demolition Boys and Tyson tied at one game a piece in the best of three finals. With the victory, the tide has turned in favor of Tala who warps the two warriors into a giant iceberg where there is no contact with the outside world. The second battle begins, and it takes little time for Tala to combine his multiple Bit Beasts into one and take the lead in the best of three finals. Meanwhile, the evil Voltaire, head of the Biovolt Corporation looks on and begins celebrating the victory, which translates into his domination of the corporate world.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing chess against Johnny and it's here where Tyson throws down the gauntlet and challenges Robert to a rematch. Robert refuses and goes into a whole history lesson about how 'once you've defeated your enemy, the battle is over.' Meanwhile, the arrogant little Johnny decides to pick a battle with the most-worthy opponent in the room and chooses Kai. As the fight begins, it appears to be even, but then Johnny calls out his Bit Beast Salamulyon and totally destroys him. In the end, the Bladebreakers resolve that they have their work cut out for them to become the world champion Beybladers!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.desc: Tanjiro and Nezuko, along with Zenitsu and Inosuke, join one of the most powerful swordsmen within the Demon Slayer Corps, Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku, to face the demon aboard the Mugen Train on track to despair.

programme.desc: Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.

programme.desc: ATA 225: Signature #6 Recap: Final Rankings Are Set for Worlds The final Signature event of the season is complete, and the road to the ACL World Championships is officially set. This week on Around The ACL, Jake, Meesh, and Anthony break down all the action from Mesa, including another Signature Doubles title for Tony Smith and Mark Richards and Logan Chamberlain's Singles championship as he continues one of the strongest stretches of the season. The crew also recaps the Women's, Seniors, and Juniors divisions, highlighting championship performances from Kamryn Belvin, Sarah Cassidy and Payton Haynes, Jeff Reynolds, Steve Schroeder and Donald Cupp, Zack Aiken, and the junior doubles team of Jack McKinney and Jayce Fleisher. To close out the show, the focus shifts to the updated doubles rankings heading into Worlds. With the regular season complete, the analysts discuss who earned the top spots, which teams have the best momentum entering the biggest event of the year, and which contenders could be poised to make a championship run. The regular season is over. Worlds are next. Join us as we break down everything that happened in Mesa and look ahead to the season's biggest stage.

programme.title: Baselines
programme.desc: Set in Los Angeles, this series follows Jamiel Chambers, a blue chip high-schooler on the brink of escaping the desperate poverty that has berated inner city America. After his junior year ends with him leading his team to a second place finish in the state's regional tournament, Jamiel is hand-picked to play in the city's annual summer league All-Star game. With college recruits swarming and pro agents hedging, the media circus leans in, peddling the question mark around his future like rabid bookies. It is this exposure that gets the attention of Nick Collins, a derelict from a disreputable family from neighboring Irvine. After his doomed-from-the-start plan to capitalize on Jamiel's notoriety ends in with fatal results, family members from both sides are pulled into a series of events which will not only effect Jamiel's trajectory, but will set up one of the most intense family feuds the city has ever witnessed.

programme.title: 4th & Forever
programme.desc: It's another big rivalry week as DeSoto faces another formidable team and 'District of Doom' foe—in Cedar Hill. Again, proximity breeds contempt and this match-up—featuring two teams that are only miles apart from one another—is certainly intense.

programme.title: 4th & Forever
programme.desc: After their victory against rival Cedar Hill—the signature win to date!—the Eagles hit their stride and wrap up their regular season. Watch snippets from the remaining three games, and meet some of the lesser-known players from the trenches.

programme.title: 4th & Forever
programme.desc: DeSoto finishes the season with an 8-2 record—with one loss against district rival, Duncanville. Now the state tournament finals are about to start, and winning the state title means everything! In the players' minds, this tournament is like a second season—and it's the ultimate proving ground.

programme.title: Cardboard Boxer
programme.desc: Willie (Thomas Haden Church) is a goodhearted man living rough on the dangerous streets of Los Angeles’ Skid Row and finds himself coerced by two rich teenagers into fighting other homeless men for cash. Stuck in a violent world he doesn’t fully understand, Willie finds solace when he discovers the discarded diary of a troubled young girl and befriends a homeless veteran, Pinky (Boyd Holbrook). A cab driver named Pope (Terrence Howard) lends Willie a blanket, looks after his friends on the street, and is protective of this little world normally condemned to invisibility. Academy Award nominees Thomas Haden Church and Terrence Howard join GONE GIRL actor Boyd Holbrook in Knate Lee’s (BAD GRANDPA, JACKASS 3D) directorial debut, a powerful tale of loss, redemption, and friendship.

programme.title: The Fail Cup
programme.desc: Lifting, parkour, wrestling, and obstacle courses are boasting feats of strength in a fight for the Fail Cup!

programme.title: The Fail Cup
programme.desc: Athletes are mounting horses, surfboards, unicycles, and snowboards in this unique battle for the Fail Cup!

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras buscan Terminus, Maggie, Sasha y Bob discuten fuertemente y terminan separándose, sin percatarse de que son más vulnerables estando solos. Mientras, Daryl y Beth han encontrado cobijo en una funeraria, pero una horda de zombis los ataca.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tyreese, Carol, Lizzie, Mika y Judith llegan a una cabaña mientras buscan Terminus. Allí, Lizzie enloquece y muestra una fascinación por la muerte que hiela la sangre de Carol y Tyreese.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Glenn y Tara se reencuentran con Maggie, Sasha y Bob en un túnel repleto de zombis mientras se aproximan a Terminus. Entretanto, Daryl se ve obligado a viajar con el mismo grupo de hombres que quiere asesinar a Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los nuevos amigos de Daryl encuentran a Rick y pretenden violar a Michonne y Carl para después matar a los tres. Mientras, Glenn, Maggie, Sasha, Bob, Tara, Abraham, Eugene y Rosita se dan cuenta de que Terminus no es el paraíso que imaginaron.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol y Tyreese llegan a las inmediaciones de Terminus y descubren que sus amigos están retenidos y van a ser sacrificados para ser comidos. Ahora, el destino de todo el grupo depende de ellos dos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo de Rick vaga por el bosque y encuentra a Gabriel, un párroco al que salvan de una horda de zombis y les permite pernoctar en su iglesia. Sin embargo, hay algo extraño en él y esa misma noche uno de los integrantes del grupo es secuestrado.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Gareth y su grupo de caníbales atacan la iglesia mientras Rick y sus compañeros están en el bosque buscándolos para vengar a Bob. Además, el padre Gabriel confiesa el siniestro acto de su pasado que no deja descansar a su conciencia.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Beth se despierta en un hospital de Atlanta, pero pronto se da cuenta de que los mismos que la auxiliaron y sanaron no la dejarán marchar. No obstante, su nuevo amigo, Noah, y ella tratan de huir del recinto.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras se dirigen hacia el norte, el grupo se ve obligado a detenerse porque una horda de zombis bloquea el camino. La tensión aumenta y la situación termina por estallar cuando Eugene confiesa un secreto que había ocultado a todos hasta ahora.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol y Daryl persiguen a los captores de Beth por una Atlanta devastada, pero su auto se queda sin gasolina y deben pasar la noche en un refugio para mujeres.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl y Noah regresan a la iglesia para pedirles ayuda a sus compañeros. Rick y otros integrantes del grupo van a Atlanta con la intención de secuestrar a varios policías para intercambiarlos por Beth y Carol.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick busca una salida pacífica al conflicto, pero sus enemigos la rechazan y prefieren zanjar las cosas de forma violenta.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick busca una salida pacífica al conflicto, pero sus enemigos la rechazan y prefieren zanjar las cosas de forma violenta.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Para cumplir con la promesa que Beth le hizo Noah antes de morir, el grupo se dirige al barrio de Noah, esperando hallar allí protección y a otros supervivientes. Sin embargo, Rick y los suyos no quieren hacerse demasiadas esperanzas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El vehículo se avería y el grupo continúa a pie hacia Washington D. C., pero les sorprende una tormenta y buscan cobijo en un granero, donde encuentran algo totalmente inesperado e inquietante.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Aarón invita al grupo a Alejandría, su comunidad, un lugar que, según él, es seguro y amigable. Rick, incapaz de olvidar Woodbury y Terminus, desconfía de Aarón, pero Michonne quiere darle una oportunidad.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los integrantes del grupo tienen entrevistas con Deanna, la jefa de Alejandría, y esperan en las casas que les asignan a saber si son aceptados o rechazados. Cuando conocen a los habitantes de la comunidad, perciben que no están bien entrenados.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick, Daryl y Carol se reúnen en secreto para planear cómo recuperar sus armas del arsenal de Alexandria, ya que temen que, si algo sale mal, van a necesitarlas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol le sugiere a Rick que deben asesinar a Pete porque es violento con su esposa e hijo. Por otra parte, Gabriel advierte a Deanna que desconfíe del grupo de Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Deanna y Rick se culpan mutuamente de las muertes de Aidenn y Noah. Rick le ofrece a Jessie protección ante Pete, pero este lo descubre y se enzarza en una pelea con él. La tensión en Alexandria aumenta y algo terrible se avecina.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Deanna quiere expulsar al grupo de Rick de Alejandría y ellos se preparan para defenderse. Sin embargo, la llegada de una banda de asaltantes y la irrupción de una horda de zombis interrumpen el enfrentamiento entre los dos bandos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick y Morgan encuentran una horda descomunal de zombis en una cantera cercana a Alejandría. Entretanto, Carter convoca a varios habitantes de Alejandría para proponerles un plan: matar a Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los Lobos, el grupo con el que ya habían combatido, asalta Alejandría y empieza a acuchillar a sus ciudadanos por las calles. Durante la pelea, Enid huye de Alejandría y Ron rechaza la ayuda de Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo trata de reconducir a la horda de zombis para alejarla de Alejandría, pero el plan falla y Glenn y Nicholas terminan rodeados por muertos vivientes. Rick, por su parte, es atacado por los asaltantes que Morgan expulsó de Alejandría.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Morgan le explica a un asaltante al que mantiene cautivo cómo venció a la ira que le consumía y aprendió que el camino correcto es aquel que rechaza la violencia.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick regresa a Alejandría, donde el ánimo está decaído por la presencia de la horda de zombis y las secuelas del asalto sufrido. Maggie y Aarón salen en busca de Glenn. Denise pierde la confianza en sí misma, pero Tara la anima.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl se separa de Abraham y Sasha mientras regresan a Alejandría. Un trío de fugitivos captura a Daryl, aunque él trata de convencerlos de que se unan a su comunidad.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Glenn encuentra a Enid y la convence de regresar junto a él a Alexandria. Mientras, en la comunidad, Ron roba armas del arsenal y Carol se enfrenta a Morgan porque no confía en él.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La horda de zombis invade Alejandría a través de la grieta que se produjo en el muro. Rick, Michonne, Carl, Gabriel y Deanna se ocultan en la casa de Jessie, pero se dan cuenta de que están rodeados.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Ahora que los caminantes han traspasado las barreras de Alejandría, Rick y los otros sobrevivientes deben seguir luchando para mantenerse a salvo e intentar no perder la esperanza.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo cree que estar en el lado de los vivos trae responsabilidades que van más allá de la supervivencia. Desde esta perspectiva, Rick comienza una lucha consigo mismo para preservar las huellas de lo que queda de humanidad.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo de Rick acompaña a Jesús a su comunidad, La Cumbre. Allí, un residente intenta matar a Gregory, el líder, por órdenes de Negan. Maggie hace un pacto con Gregory: matarán a Negan a cambio de la mitad de las provisiones que guardan.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Abraham abandona a Eugene durante una misión porque él le dice que no necesita su protección. Daryl, Rosita y Denise se topan con un grupo de los Salvadores, dirigidos por Dwight, y entre los dos bandos se produce un tiroteo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol desaparece de Alejandría y toda la comunidad se coordina para localizarla. Sin embargo, lo que algunos de ellos encuentran no es lo que andaban buscando.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Para salvar a Maggie, que se encuentra enferma, el grupo de Rick se aventura fuera de los muros de Alejandría. Pero los hombres de Negan los están esperando en la carretera.

programme.desc: Continuing their Caribbean island hopping, the Descending team contemplates underwater art in Grenada, comes face to face with the ocean’s largest carnivore in Dominica, and then goes deeper (1000+ ft!) than they ever have before.

programme.title: Descending
programme.desc: Scott and Ellis visit South Africa to face their fears and brave some of the most notorious shark-filled waters in the world. Disaster strikes on what should have been an easy shipwreck dive.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore Zunya, an eco-village, and its enchanting blue zone concept. We delve into communal living, uncovering its allure. At La Senda, we experience soul cleansing Temazcal and a sublime cacao ceremony. We engage in a farm-to-table activity, savouring locally sourced ingredients. Cala Luna offers a rejuvenating body treatment amidst serene surroundings. We encounter the Maleku Tribes, witnessing their dance ceremony and visiting their cacao farm. The journey concludes with a breath taking hike and a majestic volcano view, reminding us of nature's beauty. This episode is a transformative adventure of self-discovery, cultural immersion, and connection with nature.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: Marilia's Irish journey, meeting land enthusiasts, explored scenic spots, encounters with Ellie and Hazel, vegan delights at Cornucopia, and concluded with a reflective sunset in the Wicklow Mountains, highlighting a strong community spirit.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: Marilia's transformative Bali journey unfolded with cultural immersion and healing escapades. Tirta Empul temple brought purification and Wira's guidance. She relished nature's power at Tibumana waterfall and swung on Balinese swings. Mr. Ketut's healing, coconut blessings, and palm readings soothed her soul. The Yoga Barn's water healing session, blending watsu and dance, transported her to new realms. Serenity embraced her through local cuisine, scenic vistas, and Brian's violin melodies. Engaging with Balinese traditions, she crafted temple offerings and explored coconut oil production. Bingin Beach's natural beauty inspired reflection, while Uluwatu Surfing Villas hosted her show. A Vespa ride captured precious moments in Uluwatu's enchanting surroundings. Marilia's Bali odyssey: a harmonious blend of culture, healing, and adventure.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: Marilia had a memorable trip to Malaysia. She visited Christine's Dog Sanctuary, played with dogs, and discussed animal preservation. Emotional interviews were conducted with Angela and Christine. Marilia enjoyed a traditional Malaysian vegetarian lunch and explored dog waste management. Acro yoga with Sasa and friends brought laughter. Dr. Lee provided acupuncture sessions and explained meridian points. They met at the Ruma Hotel with stunning views of Kuala Lumpur. Marilia gathered flowers and spices at Urban Nomads Garden with Janice, who prepared a delightful coconut soup and salad. Marilia met Justin Chea, director of Kechara Soup Kitchen, and volunteered for food preparation and distribution. Filming and reflection took place at Independence Square. The trip ended with relaxation by the pool and a refreshing swim, appreciating the hotel's architecture and views. Marilia's journey in Malaysia was diverse, including animal care, wellness, culinary exploration, volunteerism, and self-reflection, making it truly memorable.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: Marilia’s journey on South Africa's Garden Route explores plant medicine, beauty in nature, and animal communication, emphasizing the profound connection between humans and the natural world.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: In Cape Town, the journey unfolds, connecting with mentors, experiencing creative breakthroughs, spiritual rituals, and ancestral connections. From this transformative experience, Marilia discovers the power of inner strength and connection.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: In this episode, Marilia explores various locations in Cornwall. She visits Boscastle, known for its witch stories, and enjoys ocean views from a field. She also explores Merlin's Cave and meets a life coach named Euan in St Neot. Marilia engages in nature bathing and encounters wildlife while walking towards Muir. At Joe's home and studio, she assists him in painting and enjoys his vinyl covers and guitar music. Marilia learns about animal massage therapy from Jenna and goes on a carriage ride through rural scenery. She joins the Seaweeders for seaweed foraging, visits the drying warehouse, and meets Gemma, an Alexander Technique specialist. Marilia also takes time to relax at a hotel spa, filming her show against the stunning ocean cliff. This episode offers a captivating exploration of Cornwall's landscapes, encounters with talented individuals, and immersive experiences.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: Marilia embarks on a captivating journey, capturing the essence of Treasure Island through extraordinary encounters. They film hidden treasures and enchanting allure against stunning backdrops. At Fort DeSoto, Marilia embraces the tranquil beauty of the beach, while Ashley leads them to Boyd Hill National Park for profound conversations beneath a magnificent tree. In Ashley's studio, a tea ceremony symbolizes tranquility and connection, followed by an intimate interview unveiling her artistry. Gulfport Beach becomes a sanctuary for transformative sound healing, and Marilia rides a bike along the boardwalk, capturing the synergy between nature and human activity. Marilia meets Justin, capturing his unique vision and creativity, and encounters Lindy, a captivating sound healer. Dolphin Yoga at CMA merges Marilia's practice with the playful marine world, while Levi guides her through an extraordinary dolphin feeding session. Clearwater Marine Aquarium showcases the dedication of the staff and educates visitors about marine conservation. In Irene's studio, Marilia explores the wellness aspect of Flamenco dance. The journey concludes at Mirror Lake, encapsulating the profound impact of Marilia's experiences through heartfelt testimonials and reflective voice-overs.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: In Joshua Tree, our journey began with Gabi, our knowledgeable astrology expert, who gracefully guided us through the mesmerizing wonders of the full moon, mercury retrogrades, and the celestial constellations. We then found ourselves immersed in the transformative realm of sound healing, led by the enchanting melodies of Alchemy. Marilia experienced profound rejuvenation as her body, mind, and soul were harmonized by the ethereal vibrations of diverse instruments.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: In the LA episode, our journey began with an awe-inspiring hike alongside the wolves. Wolf Connection revealed the magical nature of these animals and sparked a conversation about the connection between women and wolves. We then delved into Ayurveda, learning from Jay about the presence of nature in our bodies and how to maintain balance. Karla, an Ayurvedic chef, treated us to a delightful meal while emphasizing the importance of food for our well-being. Marilia fearlessly took a leap from an airplane, showing us how extreme sports can free us from fear. Lastly, Tracy showcased her life and passion for WCMX at the skate park, highlighting the joy found in pursuing our passions.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We go sea to summit with a skiing experience. We trek to an unskiied peak then go diving in the frozen ocean. Then we learn about sauna culture and how activity should be fun not work

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: From environmental health to physical health, we discover what coastal life is like in Morocco before heading inland to the desert.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We trek into the Sahara for an overnight camp and then visit the nomads. We learn how climate change is impacting life in the desert and why time should be valued.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: “Pura Vida” is a popular saying in Costa Rica, often translated as “pure life” or “simple life.” We will learn from centenarians from the Blue Zone why we should live a pure life.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We learn about conservation in Costa Rica from reforestation projects, to sustainable fishing and endangered turtle rescue. Learn why they believe in sustainability.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: Why does Sardinia stand alone as Europes Healthiest Community? Is the coast, the pastures or the mountains that grant its residences with longevity?

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: Sardinia teaches lessons of community, social connection and good foods - we learn from Dr. Ivo Pirisi what makes this island so special.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We travel to La Paz Bolivia to see how high altitude impacts the body. From science to tradition, I visit the witches market and learn about an ancient Inca medicine for altitude sickness

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: The high altitude environment makes foods that are considered “super”. From quinoai, to special beans and salt – We travel from the Uyuni Salt flats back to La Paz to work with a Master Chef.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We travel to the world’s highest lake to see what is happening in this fragile ecosystem. We finish our Bolivian adventure with a ceremony honouring our planet.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: Our small team shares our most impactful moments, stories, places and people in our wrap up episode. We share the things we brought home and how they changed our lives and our health.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Justin has been travelling alone for the past couple of months when Scott and Andre decide to come meet him at a festival in Spain. They head to Gibraltar, where Justin is attacked by candy-stealing Apes, before hopping on a ferry and completely switching continents. Now in Morocco, they head inland towards Fès, then further into the snow-covered Atlas Mountains to stay in a traditional Moroccan kasbah. They end their trip with a long climb up Jbel Toubkal – the highest mountain in North Africa. Three strong again, they find reason to keep travelling together.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: After many visa difficulties, Scott and Justin are finally allowed to enter Libya. They travel from Tripoli to Jebel Nafusa, before getting lost in the abandoned city of Ghadames. They wander around the maze of empty streets and homes before finding each other again, and drive deep into the Sahara desert to climb some of the world’s largest sand dunes, and sand-board in their own private oasis.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave & Kari visit the big island of Hawaii and see some of the most stunning beaches in the world.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: While anchored for an overnight stay along the Putumayo River, Jeff and the crew are approached by a group of Israelites—members of a little-known, non-Indigenous community that has settled deep in the Amazon to prepare for a prophesied seven-year drought. What begins as a surreal encounter takes an unexpected turn when the group requests medical help for the ailing grandson of their community leader. This urgent plea grants Jeff and the team unprecedented access to a secretive world rarely seen by outsiders—revealing a unique blend of spiritual belief, isolation, and survivalist purpose hidden deep within the jungle.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Host Will Clinger finds himself in the middle of an ice cream-related catastrophe at the Ben & Jerry’s Factory in Waterbury, Vermont; mingles with the mermaids at the underwater show in Weeki Wachee, Florida; and then marvels at the Bug Art portraits made from thousands of insects in Vermont.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving at the stunning resort of LUX* Belle Mare, Brent is amazed by their stylish, contemporary spin on luxury hospitality. Surrounded by tropical gardens and pristine white beaches, this is what everyone imagines Mauritius to be and more. He meets up with Chef Nicolas where they cook up a seafood specialty which they then enjoy under the sun on the beach. With a reef nearby, Brent rents a glass bottomed kayak and paddles out to check out the sea life. Then hopping on a bicycle, he rides to a nearby market to get the ingredients he needs for his take on a Chef Nicolas's dish, Mauritian lobster rolls, which he prepares under shady palms.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Juan Diego le pregunta a Yubiri si quiere ir al cumpleaños de Cowalscky. Ella le dice que tiene un compromiso. El le anota la dirección y le dice que si pueda que vaya. Solymar llega a la plaza y los muchachos están un poco desanimados porque no ha llegado gente. Wilker le pregunta por Yubiri y ella le dice que ya debe estar por llegar. La cena de Armando | Briggite | Atanasio y Gisela están en punto efervescente. Briggite y Gisela se tiran bombas y bombas.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Cristina está desconsolada al saber que está embarazada de Gerson porque no tiene ninguna esperanza de buena vida y la Miss intenta consolarla. Por otro lado, Matilde y Moncho quieren renunciar y Marco Aurelio está muy sorprendido por la decisión de ambos

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.desc: Walter llega a la casa de Felix y Luis Guillermo para anunciarles que Betania decidió divorciarse rápidamente y para decirles que Inés se está marchando a Nueva York para siempre. Alfredo está feliz porque ve a su hija en el retén y Diego Andrés llega para felicitarlo y pedirle que le conceda el divorcio a Marisela. Inés llega al aeropuerto y se entera que quien se va en su lugar es Betania y le deja el camino libre con Luis Guillermo quien llega a buscarlo y unos meses después, se preparan las bodas de Marisela y Diego Andrés y de Luis Guillermo con Inés y Daniela se queda a vivir en Miami, donde vive a cuerpo de reina como ella siempre quiso y le cuenta a su hermana que no piensa regresar nunca más a Venezuela.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Junior corteja a Rosa rumbo a la residencia, pero ella lo rechaza recordando la muerte de su hermano. Maricela ataca a Adolfo en plena ebriedad delante de Andreína y Rosalía. Rosa, ilusionada con Alejandro, lo ve partir sin saber que él fue a un compromiso forzado. Consuelo discute con Rosa creéndola ladrona, sin sospechar que es su hija perdida; luego se arrepiente. Eustoquio, instigado por Erasto, revela a Isaías que Consuelo tuvo una hija con Adolfo, sembrando el odio que destruirá a la familia.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Luego de la pelea en el baño con Alejandra, Irene decide regresar a su casa sin decirle a Leonardo. Ahí, su hermana Lucía le confiesa que Rodrigo Basáñez la ha estado amenazando. Agustina recibe una extraña llamada telefónica de alguien que decía ser su difunta hermana, lo cual la angustia muchísimo, ya que ese día iba a preparar una cena especial en honor a ella. Maribel le pide a Tony que revisen las cámaras de seguridad para comprobar la inocencia de Irene, pero a él se le ocurre una mejor idea para desenmascarar a Alejandra.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Luego de que Ana muriera, Sol comienza a temer aún más por su vida. El comisario Tavares considera el asesinato como una sospecha más en contra de la familia Monserrat y Alejandro sigue negando la posibilidad de que su madre esté detrás de todo eso. Eloy está dispuesto a aclarar la situación entre él y Columba. No quiere andar escondiéndose. Al encontrarse con José Domingo, Eloy le dice que piensa hacer de Columba su esposa. José Domingo va donde Columba y le dice que no tiene ninguna objeción.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene insiste en que Leonardo debe creer en su inocencia sin necesidad de pruebas. Él va a casa de su madre a buscarla, pero, tras una charla larga, ella decide tomarse un tiempo para que ambos reflexionen. Leonardo no está presente la noche de la ceremonia en memoria de Rebeca, porque fue con Anzola a buscar a Irene. Agustina se enfurece y promete revelar un secreto terrible a la familia. Camacho, quien trabaja bajo las órdenes de Rodrigo, planea entrar al departamento de las Gutiérrez y llevarse los documentos por la fuerza. Pero la llegada de Leonardo se lo impide. Sandra le pide a María Lucía que le cuente todo sobre el chico que conoció en la universidad.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro va en busca de Sol para sacarla de la cárcel y así cuidarla a ella y al bebé. Luego de una larga charla, Sol le confiesa a Alejandro que el hijo que está esperando es suyo. Maricielo sigue con el corazón roto, y Alicia decide prepararle una cita con Víctor Hugo. Eloy Arturo presenta los papeles del divorcio y habla con Reina para comunicárselo. Reina le advierte que, dentro de algunos meses, él tendrá que cambiar de idea. Giselle quiere quedar embarazada de Cristo José.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri se encuentran de regreso a su casa y comienzan los dos a decirse mentiras Carolina todavía sigue brava con Juan Diego por lo de Yubiri pero terminan besándose. Dionisia le cuenta el cuento de ROKUro a Briggite. Llega Carolina y piensa que las flores son para ella. Briggite la saca del error. En la casa de Bienvenida todos están tristes por el caso de Mayerlin. Yubiri comienza a hablar con el cuadro de Alejandro Fernández contándole como le fue el día y todo le fue malo.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Cristina encuentra a la esposa de Gerson vendiendo periódicos y aprovecha la oportunidad para despistarla sobre su gusto por él, pero sospecha algo. La esposa de Theo le pregunta a María Antonia qué le pasó en la pierna sin saber que fue a causa de él.

programme.title: Episodio 1
programme.desc: El amor entre Ricardo y Manuela florece, pero Celia, furiosa y vengativa, planea destruirlos. Tras recibir una llamada amenazante de Celia, Ricardo decide adelantar su boda para demostrarle su amor a Manuela. Mientras tanto, Katiuska regresa dispuesta a apoderarse de la fortuna Tariffi y del corazón de Ricardo. A pesar de los complots y súplicas desesperadas en su contra, Ricardo y Manuela logran casarse, pero el pasado se hace presente arruinando su luna de miel.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Isaías cae víctima de un asalto violento orquestado por Eustoquio. Alejandro, dividido, se confiesa con Amalia y conquista a Rosa con besos furtivos. Carmen rechaza a Junior por su vínculo con la muerte de Carlos. Maricela, fingiendo arrepentimiento, contrata un detective para investigar a Consuelo. Isaías, enardecido por las revelaciones de Eustoquio, exige a Consuelo la verdad sobre Adolfo. Erasto, decidido a vengar la deshonra de su hija, enfrenta a Adolfo en su propia empresa retando abiertamente al hombre que considera su peor enemigo.

programme.title: Un Milagro en Texas
programme.desc: Un Milagro en Texas es una comedia desternillante que se desarrolla en el corazón de la Gran Depresión. John Ratzenberger y Kevin Sorbo brillan interpretando a dos astutos estafadores que urden un plan para conquistar a viudas y convencerlas de invertir en sus aparentemente inútiles empresas de pozos de petróleo. Las risas no se hacen esperar mientras las viudas luchan con sus decisiones, solo para que la situación se invierta cuando un giro inesperado del destino conduce a un auténtico hallazgo de petróleo.

programme.title: Ana Karénina
programme.desc: Encuentro en la estación: Anna Arkadievna Karenina, esposa de un alto funcionario del gobierno, llega a Moscú para ayudar a su hermano Stiva en una difícil situación familiar. En la estación de tren, conoce por casualidad al joven y distinguido oficial Alexéi Alexandrovich Vronski…

programme.title: Ana Karénina
programme.desc: Las carreras de oficiales: Karenina y Vronski se reencuentran durante una competencia ecuestre. Un desafortunado error de Vronski provoca la caída y muerte de su caballo. Profundamente afectada por la escena, Anna pierde el conocimiento y, en su angustia, le confiesa todo a su esposo…

programme.title: Ana Karénina
programme.desc: La boda: El terrateniente Levin le propone matrimonio por segunda vez a Kiti Shcherbátskaya, y en esta ocasión, ella acepta…

programme.title: Ana Karénina
programme.desc: Esa no soy yo: Anna da a luz a una niña. Dos pensamientos la atormentan: la culpa hacia su esposo y el miedo a la muerte durante el parto. Finalmente, consigue que su marido perdone a Vronski…

programme.title: Amada
programme.desc: Semyon Tarasov era una gerente exitoso, que hace un año dejo su trabajo el hipermercado “La Almohada favorita”. Después de culminar sus estudios y prácticas en el extranjero regresó a trabajar a la misma empresa, pero ya como director de la sucursal. Antes le llamaban simplemente Syoma, ahora debían llamarle por su nombre y patronímico, es decir, Semyon Olegovich. ¡Pero qué difícil es convencer a la gente de que ahora las reglas del juego han cambiado y que en lugar de un trato amistoso debería haber respeto! ¿Cómo inculcar asombro y respeto en los empleados? Aquí todos lo conocen como Syoma, el que animaba enérgicamente al equipo de fútbol en el bar con sus amigos, iba a hacer rafting en el río con otros, y con una mujer... con Lena ... Lena! Fueron pareja durante casi un año y vivían juntos, hasta que a Syoma le ofrecieron una pasantía. Él y Lena se amaban, y luego... ¿Qué pasó entonces? Entonces Syoma se convenció a sí mismo de que no se amaban en lo absoluto, sino que se tenían afecto, intimidad y una vida juvenil juntos. Se convenció de esto a sí mismo para no sentirse un vil traidor, porque sabía que había dejado a Lena por su carrera. Y Syoma realmente no falló en al lograr sus sueños. ¿y que paso con Lena? a Syoma se le olvidó lo hermosa que es. ¡Pero qué es esto! ¿Lena... está embarazada? Syoma cuenta frenéticamente los meses y los días y comprende que no es posible que él sea el padre de este niño. Si en dado caso Lena estuviera embarazada y estuviera a punto de dar a luz, tendría solo nueve meses de embarazo, pero Syoma no ha estado en Moscú desde hace 12 meses!

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Una serie policíaca sobre un misterioso asesino en serie. Ver Enséñame a vivir online para descubrir qué es lo que impide a los civiles dormir tranquilos. Durante años, la ciudad fue pacífica antes de que llegara el asesino. Los habitantes de la ciudad se sentían seguros y protegidos, pero ahora todos temen por sus vidas. Las víctimas del asesino van en aumento. La policía consigue atrapar al presunto asesino y ponerlo entre rejas. El caso puede cerrarse, pero se produce otro asesinato. La gente está asustada. Un psiquiatra está listo para ayudar en la investigación. Está dispuesto a reunirse con el sospechoso. El criminal revela al médico una verdad aterradora y muy peligrosa.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: La investigación revela que hace 25 años hubo una serie de asesinatos con un modus operandi similar. El asesino, Kosarev, cumple cadena perpetua en prisión y recientemente solicitó libertad condicional, pero la comisión encabezada por Lavrov rechazó su solicitud. La relación entre Storozheva y Lavrov es tensa. Juntos visitan al exdetective Puchkov, quien trabajó en el caso original, pero este se niega a ayudar y actúa de manera sospechosa. Al vigilarlo, descubren su conexión con Gavrishin, quien en su momento fue el principal sospechoso de los asesinatos.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Puchkov se reúne con Kosarev en prisión. Este último cree que los nuevos asesinatos pueden probar su inocencia. Gavrishin, sintiéndose nuevamente sospechoso, atrae a Lavrov a una imprenta abandonada para contarle su versión de los hechos. Rita y el oficial Tolik llegan al lugar, pero durante la detención, Gavrishin sufre un shock insulínico. Esa misma noche, asesinan a otra mujer, quien resulta ser paciente de Lavrov en la clínica psiquiátrica.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Rita se encuentra con la exesposa de Lavrov, Katya, para verificar su coartada. Convencida de su inocencia, informa a Nikushin, su superior, que Lavrov parece ser el verdadero objetivo del asesino y que su esposa podría ser la próxima víctima. Nikushin se encarga personalmente de la seguridad de Katya. Mientras tanto, Rita descubre que Kosarev tuvo un hermano menor que murió en la infancia. Por otro lado, Lavrov sospecha de uno de sus pacientes, Starostin, quien sufre de trastorno de identidad disociativo.

La relación entre Storozheva y Lavrov es tensa. Juntos visitan al exdetective Puchkov, quien trabajó en el caso original, pero este se niega a ayudar y actúa de manera sospechosa. Al vigilarlo, descubren su conexión con Gavrishin, quien en su momento fue el principal sospechoso de los asesinatos.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Puchkov se reúne con Kosarev en prisión. Este último cree que los nuevos asesinatos pueden probar su inocencia. Gavrishin, sintiéndose nuevamente sospechoso, atrae a Lavrov a una imprenta abandonada para contarle su versión de los hechos. Rita y el oficial Tolik llegan al lugar, pero durante la detención, Gavrishin sufre un shock insulínico. Esa misma noche, asesinan a otra mujer, quien resulta ser paciente de Lavrov en la clínica psiquiátrica.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Rita se encuentra con la exesposa de Lavrov, Katya, para verificar su coartada. Convencida de su inocencia, informa a Nikushin, su superior, que Lavrov parece ser el verdadero objetivo del asesino y que su esposa podría ser la próxima víctima. Nikushin se encarga personalmente de la seguridad de Katya. Mientras tanto, Rita descubre que Kosarev tuvo un hermano menor que murió en la infancia. Por otro lado, Lavrov sospecha de uno de sus pacientes, Starostin, quien sufre de trastorno de identidad disociativo.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Una serie policíaca sobre un misterioso asesino en serie. Ver Enséñame a vivir online para descubrir qué es lo que impide a los civiles dormir tranquilos. Durante años, la ciudad fue pacífica antes de que llegara el asesino. Los habitantes de la ciudad se sentían seguros y protegidos, pero ahora todos temen por sus vidas. Las víctimas del asesino van en aumento. La policía consigue atrapar al presunto asesino y ponerlo entre rejas. El caso puede cerrarse, pero se produce otro asesinato. La gente está asustada. Un psiquiatra está listo para ayudar en la investigación. Está dispuesto a reunirse con el sospechoso. El criminal revela al médico una verdad aterradora y muy peligrosa.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: In Switzerland, everything you need is right in the backyard. That might be tough to believe while taking in the staggering peaks and powdery snow, but the DIRT crew learned it firsthand on their latest adventure. The key? The warmth and resourcefulness of the Swiss people. Josh and co got the lay of the land from chef Sarah Lämmli, foraging wild ramps, moss, and dried leaves on the outskirts of Lucerne. Then they worked their way up, carving lines into Interlaken’s ski slopes and learning how the locals thrive (and even make speakeasies out of ice) in the abundant mountain landscape.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: For many protected reserves across Africa, the elephant populations are expanding, and this comes with a critical problem: what happens to the elephants when an area reaches carrying capacity? Dan Cabela investigates the growing problem, visiting Zimbabwe, Namibia and Angola to explore the future of elephant conservation.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff scour the rugged mountains of southern Arizona in search of the elusive Coues deer, known to hunters as the “Grey Ghost.” Through scorching sun and shifting winds, they test their skill and patience chasing one of North America’s most elusive big game animals.

programme.title: The Reel American Road Trip
programme.desc: Danny discovers two northern Michigan watering holes and fishing with a local guide, Reel Tales Fishing Charters.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: From battling towering 12-foot waves in the Gulf of Alaska, to reeling in colossal 200 lb. halibut, they discover firsthand the rugged beauty of America's 49th state. This episode highlights Lindell Yachts as a top builder of rugged offshore sportfishing yachts, as well as Radon Boats as great pilothouse fishing and guide boats.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael and Larken travel to South Carolina's Lowcountry for a massive barbecue charity event supporting children battling serious illness. After serving up smoke for a great cause, they spend an extra day in the marsh chasing redfish and speckled trout.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: On this episode of Goin' Coastal, Capt. Josh Calhoon brings his store manager Isaiah Lopez with him on a day of inshore fishing for trout and redfish.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: Could dinosaurs still walk the Earth? Deep in the Congo, legends say yes. In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green investigates the chilling reports of Mokele-mbembe, a dinosaur-like creature said to inhabit the remote swamps of the Congo Basin. We dive into real expedition footage, indigenous stories, and eyewitness accounts that all point to one shocking possibility: something ancient may still be alive in the heart of Africa. From early missionary reports in the 1900s to modern explorers risking their lives to chase the unknown, we piece together the long-standing mystery surrounding alleged dinosaur sightings in Africa. Whether you're into cryptids, paleontology, or just love a good wilderness mystery, this episode will have you questioning what’s really hiding in the unexplored corners of the Earth.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Captain Josh takes Don from LBP inshore fishing for species he's never caught before, with one unforgettable battle stealing the show.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Despite the weather, Capt. Josh Calhoon and his wife Anna take a day off to target mangrove snapper before moving into deeper water to search for quality amberjacks.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: In this episode of Goin' Coastal, Captain Josh and Anna Calhoon set out for some fun Flounder fishing. They enjoy a delicious hook & cook served up fresh from their day at AJ's!

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: With rods bent and fish in the box, Capt. Josh and Alex Fogg reel in a variety of species to assist with important research on fish growth and population health.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: The Green Way team continue their African journey with hunts for both the majestic Kudu and elusive Golden Wildebeest. The experience comes full circle when the meat from these animals is donated to local schoolchildren, who receive not only fresh meals but also school supplies and sweets that light up the village.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff join a local biologist searching for a white rhino whose tracking collar has failed, leaving it exposed to poachers. As they follow its trail through the African bush, the search builds toward a heart-pounding encounter that none of them will ever forget.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle takes to the water in a way few anglers dare, fishing from a Sea-Doo in search of the ancient lake sturgeon, a species that’s been around since the age of the dinosaurs and can live over 100 years. Hooking into one of North America’s largest freshwater fish from a personal watercraft proves to be a challenge unlike any other.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff wade into the flooded timber of the legendary Coca-Cola Woods, where mallards drop through the treetops in waves. Amidst echoes of calling and wingbeats, they experience one of America’s most iconic duck hunts.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: As an avid bird hunter who grew up sharing his passion with his dad, Mark Peterson has traveled the globe pursuing his favorite game. After completing the North America Upland Slam and the New Zealand Wingshooting Slam both in a single season, he’s setting his sights on the South America Upland Slam.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: On day three of Mark Peterson’s South America Upland Slam adventure, the guys are snowed in while waiting to head to La Pampa, where the weather promised to be much better. After a tense wait for the go-ahead to fly out, they finally touched down in La Pampa and headed straight to the field. There, the grasslands and scattered thickets provide the perfect habitat for Bushed Tinamou, known for their elusive nature and penchant for hiding among dense underbrush. Day four is dedicated to hunting these Tinamou, with Mark eager to track them in their natural habitat. On day five, their focus shifts to Pigeons, where they set up decoys along the edge of a cut cornfield. The anticipation of drawing in flocks makes for an incredible hunt and Mark can’t wait to see what the day will bring.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: In this episode, Mark Peterson finds himself deep in the heart of Peru and focuses on completing the prestigious South America Upland Slam. With only one bird remaining, the Western Peruvian Dove, the trip has led him to a private hunting property. This final challenge will take place over a cut cornfield, a favorite spot for the doves. To blend in, Mark and his team craft a makeshift blind using a mix of corn stalks, and timber, just enough cover while allowing for a clear shot. These West Peruvian Doves are known for their erratic flight patterns, often bouncing from one tree to another in a random manner, making timing and placement critical.

programme.title: The Bearded Buck
programme.desc: Jerry and Austin are back in the Cornhusker state again! But this time, they're going there for antelope! This is Austin's first time ever attempting to hunt these elusive animals and patience is the name of the game.

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode, we travel to Walker, Minnesota to highlight a great organization tucked back in the woods called Camp Bliss! Camp Bliss hosts a wide arrange of events throughout the year that are tailored for Veterans to find rest, relaxation and respite. We tag along on an Ice Fishing outing, a turkey hunt and a Women's Veterans retreat as we highlight this great organization and the heroes they serve. We also highlight Des Moine Iowa SCHEELS hometown hero, Navy Veteran Steve Booth!

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode, we travel to Parker, South Dakota for a European pheasant hunt at Wings of Valor Lodge! The South Dakota DAV chapter is onsite for a great day of hunting and fellowship. We also honor Missoula Scheels Hometown Hero, Anton Johnson!

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: WWII U.S. Navy veteran Bill Kruschel recounts a journey from humble beginnings in the midst of the Great Depression to his valuable service in the Navy, culminating in a lifelong commitment to the field of special education.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: An Honor No One Wants: A Gold Star Family is the immediate family member(s) of a fallen soldier who died while serving in a time of conflict. Kelli Campbell Goodnow honors the memory her husband…American hero Shawn Campbell.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Youth turkey season in Alabama is always special, but this one means a little bit more. Isaac takes Dylan Hunt to the woods for Alabama’s Youth Opening Weekend with hopes of calling in Dylan a gobbler. Youth season is all about passing on the tradition, and there’s nothing better than watching the next generation experience the thrill of turkey hunting.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: The Alabama turkey opener is a tradition we look forward to every single year. This season, Aaron and Nick from The Hunting Public joined us in camp to kick things off and experience the opener with us. Good friends, strong tradition, and some Alabama gobblers made for an unforgettable start to the season.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: It's the second day of the Alabama Turkey season, and we hit the woods with Dr. Mike Chamberlain and Aaron Warbritton from The Hunting Public in search of a longbeard. Watching turkeys just being turkeys, and spending time with great friends is why turkey hunting is just different to us.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way

Billy Yargus and Phillip Vanderpool are at Hidden Valley Outfitters in Arnold, Nebraska for a turkey hunt that turned into one they will never forget. Patience, experience, and elite calling paid off when these longbeards finally committed, and came all the way to 20 steps.

Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.
